title: Divine wisdom abhors pardon for the obstinate who trample Christ’s blood
source_text: VIII. Et certe a sapientia divina prorsus abhorret, ut poenas peccato debitas vitet ille qui in peccato se obfirmat, nec vult ab eo desistere: & ut fiat beneficii mortis Christi particeps, qui sanguinem Christi conculcat, & recusat ipsi parere, eumque tanquam Servatorem & Redemptorem suum colere atque agnoscere.
pass_a_gloss: And certainly it utterly abhors divine wisdom that he should avoid the penalties owed to sin who hardens himself in sin and is unwilling to desist from it; and that he should become a partaker of the benefit of Christ’s death who tramples the blood of Christ and refuses to obey him and to worship and acknowledge him as his Savior and Redeemer.
pass_b_english: Wisdom will not spare the obstinate who will not leave sin.
Nor share Christ’s death-benefit with those who trample his blood and refuse him as Savior.
